title: Create test_full_pipeline.py exercising all 6 compiler layers
objective: Create the crown jewel test from PLAN-A A10.1 that exercises all 6 compiler layers end-to-end for both elastic and plastic paths, with artifact bundle completeness assertion.

plan_assets.asset_description: Full pipeline test specification with 6 layers

scope: Two test methods: elastic SVK cantilever and plastic J2 uniaxial
Each exercises: build_context -> ProblemIR -> localise -> optimize -> emit -> golden comparison
implementation_steps: Assert ArtifactBundle has problem_ir_dict, element_ir_summary, contraction_plans (3), emitted_source
deliverables: tests/test_full_pipeline.py with two comprehensive test methods
Both tests pass and exercise all 6 layers
acceptance_criteria: All 6 compiler layers exercised for both elastic and plastic

cases: test_elastic_full_pipeline: 6-layer SVK cantilever pipeline, artifact bundle completeness, golden comparison vs tests/golden/elastic_cantilever.npz
test_plastic_full_pipeline: 6-layer J2 uniaxial pipeline, artifact bundle completeness, golden comparison vs tests/golden/plastic_uniaxial.npz

risks: Layer 4b (einsum optimizer) contraction_plans count must equal 3 -- if the upstream optimizer emits a different number the completeness assertion will need updating in lockstep
Golden files elastic_cantilever.npz / plastic_uniaxial.npz must stay in sync with the emitted source; regenerating requires an explicit intent step (see P6-3)
Reuses _make_elastic_problem_ir / _make_plastic_problem_ir from test_e2e.py -- any signature drift there will silently break this test
completion_notes: Implemented full-pipeline e2e tests inside packages/mechdsl-core/tests/test_full_pipeline.py with a local frontend-context adapter and golden regression checks against elastic_cantilever.npz and plastic_uniaxial.npz.
